title: OwlCam nest box — 40-pin header
summary: Thirteen positions on the GPIO header carry power, ground, I²C, I²S, and the IR drive. CSI camera and USB peripherals use other ports on the Pi.

wiringDiagram.alt: OwlCam Raspberry Pi 4 wiring schematic showing thirteen GPIO header connections to the nest microphone, climate sensor, and IR illuminator power path.
wiringDiagram.caption: Field wiring schematic (13 header pins). Green cells in the interactive map below match this diagram.

callouts.name: BME280 — nest climate
callouts.role: Temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure on /diagnostics and the Pi vitals history.

callouts.name: INMP441 — nest microphone
callouts.role: I²S audio muxed into the live HLS stream (GPIO 18 / 19 / 20).

callouts.name: IR illuminator power
callouts.role: 5 V into LM2596 buck (3.0 V) to the IR LED board through the MOSFET load terminals.

callouts.name: IRF520 + GPIO drive
callouts.role: Ground references and GPIO 23 to MOSFET SIG; owlcam-ir pulses the light at night.

callouts.name: IMX708 camera (CSI)
callouts.role: Primary /owl video — not on the 40-pin header.

callouts.name: USB camera
callouts.role: Secondary /owl2 angle — not on the 40-pin header.

headerPins.helps: 3.3 V sensor rail. Powers the I²S microphone and the climate chip; do not feed 5 V to these parts.
Pi 5 V feeds the buck converter that steps down to 3.0 V for the IR illuminator load through the MOSFET.
I²C data for nest air temperature, humidity, and pressure on /diagnostics and the vitals history file.
I²C clock paired with GPIO2. Keep leads short inside the box to reduce noise on the bus.
Primary ground return for the microphone (including L/R strap) and the BME280.
Extra ground tie in the harness for a solid reference between nest-box boards and the Pi.
I²S bit clock for nest audio muxed into the live HLS feed (overlay maps GPIO18 to PCM_CLK).
Logic ground for the MOSFET driver board that switches the IR illuminator.
Software-driven high turns the MOSFET on (owlcam-ir). Short night bursts; 60 s thermal cap in firmware.
Return for the buck converter input; pairs with pin 2 for the IR power path.
I²S left/right clock (GPIO19 / PCM_FS) for mono nest audio.
I²S serial data from the mic into the Pi (GPIO20 / PCM_DIN).
Additional ground at the far end of the header for the field wiring bundle.

otherPorts.helps: Primary nest video: 1080p H.264 into MediaMTX path /owl. Not a GPIO pin.
Second angle on /owl2 via ffmpeg; uses the USB bus, not the 40-pin header.
